model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the “Performance Gap (%)” across a set of 12 model/category entries, with each entry shown as a single colored bar and an exact numeric value annotated above it. The categories are arranged along the horizontal axis, but the category labels are not visible in the provided image; there is no legend indicating what each color represents. The vertical axis is the value axis and is labeled “Performance Gap (%)”; it uses a linear scale from 0 to 30 with regularly spaced tick marks at 5-unit intervals (0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30). From left to right, the bars are colored in distinct pastel shades (green, purple, blue, mauve, gray-blue, brown, light blue, lavender, beige, light gray, pale yellow, and light pink) and have annotated values of approximately 15.15, 25.66, 9.60, 11.37, 28.29, 18.80, 21.88, 23.79, 17.27, 22.41, 23.47, and 24.01 percent, respectively, with the smallest annotated bar at 9.60% and the largest at 28.29%. The bars appear as a single series (not grouped or stacked), are not shown as explicitly sorted by height or alphabetically based on the visible information, and none are visually emphasized beyond the uniform value labels above each bar.
